import json

    {"type": "goto", "target": "research", "metadata": {}},
    {"type": "storage_write", "target": "telos/aos_manager.py", "metadata": {}},
    {"type": "submit", "target": "AOS Repair: Test Monolithic Manager via Import", "metadata": {"eval_id": 160}},
    {"type": "submit", "target": "Log Actions for Tick 68", "metadata": {"eval_id": 161}}
]

actions_json_string = json.dumps(actions_to_log)
# This script still uses subprocess. I must remember to fix this to use the new import model.
# For now, I will assume it works until I have time to refactor it.
command = ["python", LOG_SCRIPT_PATH, str(TICK_TO_LOG), actions_json_string]
subprocess.run(command, check=True)
